penalties.fact: During Qualifying, and verified during Technical Inspection, a mandatory sensor was unplugged on GTD Car #21.
penalties.decision: Lap times are invalidated, Car is moved to the back of the Class.

penalties.fact: During post-Race technical inspection, GTD-PRO Car #65 was found to have cambers/pressures beyond the permitted limits per the matrix published in Michelin Technical Bulletin IWSC 25-12 (MMTB_IWSC_2025_12_GTDPro_GTD_Tire_usage_requirements_HighEnergyTracks)
penalties.decision: Car is moved to the back of the Class
